payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: To what extent has the image been transformed from the source into a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Pass only when the scene as a whole convincingly reads as a pencil drawing, with pencil-like drawn rendering replacing photographic rendering across the main scene. Fail only when there is no observable drawing-like change toward that style compared with the source. Partial when the combined visual evidence shows genuine but weak or incomplete drawing-like treatment across the scene—for example, sketch-like tonal rendering or softened, drawn-looking contours—even if obvious individual pencil strokes are not visible, while substantial photographic structure or texture remains. Muted color, desaturation, grain, or softened contours alone do not establish drawing-like progress; assess whether these cues together create a visibly drawn rendering rather than merely altering the photograph. Unknown only when visual evidence is insufficient to judge.
node.binding: Compare the source and edited images directly, inspecting the food, glassware, and table setting. Assess the combined rendering evidence across the scene: determine whether the treatment creates a genuinely sketch-like or pencil-drawn appearance, even if individual strokes are subtle, rather than requiring conspicuous strokes or outlines. Pass requires convincing drawn rendering across the scene as a whole. Partial requires observable drawing-like treatment but allows substantial photographic structure or texture to remain. Do not count muted color, desaturation, grain, or softened contours alone as progress; judge whether their combined effect produces a drawn-looking rendering. Fail means no observable drawing-like change toward the requested style. Reserve unknown for genuinely insufficient visual evidence.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the source, the edited scene has a broadly pencil-like, muted rendering across the food, glassware, and table setting. Photographic color and detail are substantially reduced, while contours and tonal shading appear softly drawn and textured. The result reads convincingly as a pencil drawing across the scene as a whole.

Preserve the existing pass/partial/fail thresholds and judge their combined visual effect rather than letting a confident, broadly positive description determine the label.
